dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with near-zero curvature, lacking standard falcate geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute point with minimal pixel radius; classified as acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Small radius curve fitting a tight, highly convex anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt projection with a pixel length nearly equal to its base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 130 degrees at the rostrum-melon junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Bioluminescent-like cyan light emission localized within the orbital/eye region.
